privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.introText: GrowBoard is a client-side productivity application that operates entirely within your web browser. We are fundamentally committed to your privacy. This policy explains our approach to data handling — which, in short, is that we do not collect, store, or process any of your personal data.
privacyPolicy.noDataText: GrowBoard does not collect any personal information, usage data, or analytics of any kind. We do not use cookies for tracking, we do not deploy analytics scripts, and we do not record your interactions with the application.
privacyPolicy.noBackendText: GrowBoard has no backend infrastructure. There are no servers that receive, process, or store your data. The application runs entirely in your browser. Your data exists in two places only:
privacyPolicy.noBackendList1: Your browser's local storage (Zustand persisted state)
privacyPolicy.noBackendList2: Your personal Google Drive (as Google Sheets files you control)
privacyPolicy.googleOAuthText: GrowBoard uses Google OAuth 2.0 for authentication. When you sign in, Google provides an access token directly to your browser. This token is stored only in your browser's local storage and is used exclusively to interact with your own Google Drive. GrowBoard never receives, transmits, or stores your Google password.
privacyPolicy.googleDriveText: GrowBoard requests access to Google Drive and Google Sheets in order to read and write your productivity data (credentials, plans, expenses, goals, etc.) as Google Sheets files. This data resides entirely in your personal Google Drive account. GrowBoard cannot access any other user's Drive, and we have no ability to view or retrieve your files.
privacyPolicy.thirdPartyText: GrowBoard does not integrate with any third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking services. The only third-party service involved is Google (for OAuth and Drive storage), and your interaction with Google is governed by Google's own privacy policy.
privacyPolicy.changesText: If we ever change this privacy policy, we will update the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page. Since GrowBoard does not collect email addresses, we cannot send notifications of changes — we encourage you to review this page periodically.
privacyPolicy.contactText: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please open an issue on the GrowBoard GitHub repository.

dataPolicy.title: Data Policy
dataPolicy.overviewText: GrowBoard is a Google Drive-first application. All your data is stored as Google Sheets in your personal Google Drive. This document explains exactly how your data flows, where it is stored, and what control you have over it.
dataPolicy.storageText: GrowBoard stores data in exactly two locations:
dataPolicy.storageList1Text: A cached copy of your workspace is persisted in your browser using Zustand's persist middleware. This enables offline-first performance and instant page loads without network requests.
dataPolicy.storageList2Text: Your authoritative data is stored as Google Sheets files in your personal Google Drive account. Each module (credentials, expenses, plans, goals, learnings, resources) maps to its own spreadsheet.
dataPolicy.flowText: When you use GrowBoard, data flows as follows:
dataPolicy.flowList1: Your browser reads and writes directly to Google Sheets via the Google Sheets API.
dataPolicy.flowList2: API calls are made from your browser using your OAuth access token.
dataPolicy.flowList3: No data passes through any GrowBoard-operated server or intermediary.
dataPolicy.flowList4: Changes are cached locally for offline access and synced on reconnection.
dataPolicy.ownershipText: You own all your data. Since everything is stored in your Google Drive:
dataPolicy.ownershipList1: You can view, edit, or delete your data directly in Google Sheets at any time.
dataPolicy.ownershipList2: You can export your data in any format Google Sheets supports (CSV, XLSX, PDF, etc.).
dataPolicy.ownershipList3: You can revoke GrowBoard's access via your Google Account settings at any time.
dataPolicy.ownershipList4: Deleting the app or clearing browser data removes the local cache but your Drive data remains intact.
dataPolicy.encryptionText: All communication between your browser and Google's APIs is encrypted via HTTPS/TLS. Data at rest in Google Drive is protected by Google's infrastructure-level encryption. Local browser storage is protected by your device's own security measures.
dataPolicy.retentionText: GrowBoard does not retain any data. When you clear your browser storage, the local cache is gone. When you delete files from your Google Drive, they are gone. There are no backups, no replicas, and no shadow copies maintained by GrowBoard.
dataPolicy.sharingText: GrowBoard never shares your data with any third party. Since there is no backend server, there is no mechanism for data to be shared, sold, or transferred. Your data stays between your browser and your Google Drive — period.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.acceptanceText: By accessing or using GrowBoard, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you should not use the application.
terms.serviceText: GrowBoard is a free, open-source, client-side productivity application that runs entirely in your web browser. It provides tools for managing credentials, expenses, plans, goals, learnings, and resources. All data is stored in your personal Google Drive as Google Sheets.
terms.accountText: To use GrowBoard's full functionality, you need a Google account. By signing in, you authorize GrowBoard to access your Google Drive and Google Sheets on your behalf. You are responsible for maintaining the security of your Google account credentials.
terms.responsibilitiesList1: Use GrowBoard in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
terms.responsibilitiesList2: Not attempt to reverse-engineer, modify, or distribute the application in ways that violate its license.
terms.responsibilitiesList3: Take responsibility for the data you store in your Google Drive via GrowBoard.
terms.responsibilitiesList4: Maintain the security of your own Google account and browser environment.
terms.warrantyText: GrowBoard is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee that the application will be error-free, uninterrupted, or suitable for any particular purpose. Use of the application is at your own risk.
terms.liabilityText: In no event shall the creators or contributors of GrowBoard be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising out of or in connection with your use of the application, including but not limited to data loss, security breaches of your Google account, or interruption of service.
terms.dataText: Since all data is stored in your Google Drive, you are solely responsible for backing up, securing, and managing your data. GrowBoard does not maintain copies of your data and cannot recover deleted information.
terms.modificationsText: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be reflected by updating the "Last Updated" date at the top of this page. Continued use of GrowBoard after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
terms.governingText: These terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with applicable laws, without regard to conflict of law principles.
